key_insight: AI agents can make human discussions more responsive and broaden human-generated ideas, even though AI-generated conversations are less semantically diverse than human conversations.
engineering_relevance: The findings may inform AI facilitators for collaborative engineering discussions, but the study does not evaluate materials discovery or engineering outcomes.
method: Introduce generic and persona-conditioned AI agents into evolving discussions.
Compare conversational outcomes in agent-based simulations grounded in Reddit discussions across four domains.
Test human-only and hybrid human–AI discussions in a pre-registered experiment.
evidence_signal: A pre-registered experiment with 221 participants across nine discussion threads found that AI participation increased responsiveness, reduced unanswered contributions, and broadened ideas expressed by humans.
watch_item: Persona conditioning narrowed the semantic-diversity gap, but increasing underrepresented persona representation did not necessarily increase overall diversity.
paper_title: AI-human hybrid conversations: Can AI Agents Improve Discourse Quality?
